name: Yamakono Mura - Kichiku Murabito to Nagusami no Miko
original_name: やまこの村 鬼畜村人と慰みの巫女
source:
Where every night, shrine maidens are ravished by the locals...

The protagonist is a teacher on dispatch to rural Yamakono Mura,
where he gets to know two loli students: Miyako and Haru.
To his great surprise, he sees Miyako f*cking the villagers at the local shrine.
It's a debauched festival that continues until dawn.
As for Haru, she calls her pornographic trysts "dates", and has one
with the protagonist. They carry on this way for days...

Who will the protagonist choose? 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE188115.html]DLsite English[/url]]

每天晚上，巫女都会被当地人蹂躏……

令他大吃一惊的是，他看到宫子在当地神社和村民们做爱。
这是一个持续到黎明的放荡节日。

与主角。他们就这样持续了好几天……
